name: Sakhin Gata
ingredients: String or bamboo twine for tying
instructions: 1. Soak the sticky rice in water for a few hours until softened.
2. Drain the water and stuff the soaked rice into hollow bamboo tubes.
3. Add a small amount of water to the tube to facilitate steaming.
4. Seal the open end of the bamboo tube securely with banana leaves.
5. Place the bamboo tubes over an open fire or hot coals, rotating occasionally until the rice is thoroughly cooked and fragrant.
description: Sakhin Gata is a cultural delicacy of the Garo tribe in Meghalaya. It is traditionally prepared during festivals and community gatherings, showcasing the ancient cooking technique of using bamboo to infuse a unique, earthy aroma into the sticky rice.
